title: Whole-operation annotation writer allocation rollback and retry
scope: Exercise direct public writer entry points for generated SOLID, TRACE, LIGHT and CAMERA-to-VIEW profiles alongside all seven standard typed DIMENSION subtypes, ARC_DIMENSION, LARGE_RADIAL_DIMENSION, TOLERANCE, RTEXT and ARCALIGNEDTEXT in the whole-operation ASCII/Binary allocation failure sweep.

commonFields.construction: Typed DRW_* dimension records serialized in the existing generated whole-operation drawing

allocationSweep.ascii: 698/698 offsets injected; previous destination, caller fields, and derived identity maps preserved; same-writer retry reproduced clean output and typed readback passed.
allocationSweep.binary: 689/689 offsets injected; previous destination, caller fields, and derived identity maps preserved; same-writer retry reproduced clean output and typed readback passed.

validation.readback: Exactly one callback was delivered for each of the seven standard subtypes, ARC_DIMENSION, LARGE_RADIAL_DIMENSION, TOLERANCE, RTEXT and ARCALIGNEDTEXT, plus SOLID, TRACE, LIGHT, CAMERA and VIEW. Common text/style fields and subtype-specific WCS/OCS geometry match typed profiles; large radial chord, overridden center, jog point and group-40 jog angle match; tolerance style, text, insertion, extrusion and axis match; RTEXT style, position, height, rotation, flags, text and extrusion match; arc-aligned text geometry, font names, D2T fields, color, flags and text match; direct SOLID and TRACE entry points preserve four corners; LIGHT fields match; the remapped CAMERA code-340 handle equals the remapped emitted VIEW handle, and VIEW identity/geometry match.

limitations: This verifies allocation rollback/retry and typed DXF roundtrip only; it does not qualify native entity presentation or producer-specific DWG semantics.
The CAMERA graph proof covers one generated VIEW record and one handle role; broader VIEW dependencies and producer variants remain open.
Custom/dynamic dimension profiles and broader public writer profiles remain outside this control.
No full test suite was run.
fixturePolicy: No DWG/DXF fixture was committed; the drawing is generated by the test in scratch storage.
